clue.text: One-time comic feast

old British slang for a party or celebratory meal

clue.text: Fat insect studied by the lepidopterist

a fly is an insect

parts.note: the letters S and N, spoken by name

clue.text: He raises his glass to Daisy

definitions.text: He raises his glass to Daisy

parts.words: He raises his glass to Daisy
parts.note: one who proposes a drink to someone's health, here a woman called Daisy
